events.verdict: LLB shows Ingram (LAL) reaches for and misses the ball, making contact with Irving (BOS) that causes him to lose control of the ball.
After the defensive switch on the screen, Morris (BOS) engages with Kuzma (LAL) and wraps two arms around his body, which prevents him from freely rolling towards the basket.
Morris (BOS) has his hand extended but he does not deliver contact to Kuzma's (LAL) back on his shot attempt.
Horford (BOS) is already in Kuzma's (LAL) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
RAR shows Chandler (LAL) is already in Morris' (BOS) path when contact occurs and he does not deliver contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] James (LAL) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
LAR shows Irving (BOS) maintains legal guarding position and makes incidental contact with James (LAL) that does not affect his SQBR.
LAR shows Irving (BOS) maintains legal guarding position and James (LAL) loses control of the ball on his own.
Rondo (LAL) makes marginal contact with Irving (BOS) at the end of his drive.
RLS shows Rondo (LAL) cleanly dislodges the ball from Smart (BOS). Any ensuing contact to Smart's hand/arm is considered incidental.

Horford (BOS) does not establish a legal screening position in Ingram's (LAL) path and contact occurs to his side. Additionally, Horford re-establishes himself in Ingram's path after the initial contact.
PXP shows Caldwell-Pope (LAL) wraps Tatum (BOS) during the inbound.
Rondo (LAL) inbounds the ball within five seconds.
Morris (BOS) makes marginal contact with James (LAL) that does not affect his SQBR.
[Observable in enhanced video] Ingram (LAL) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Ingram (LAL) places his hand momentarily on Irving's (BOS) side during the inbound.
Kuzma (LAL) maintains legal guarding position as he defends Irving's (BOS) driving shot attempt.
Irving (BOS) does not extend his arm into Kuzma's (LAL) body and he does not affect Kuzma's ability to defend the shot.

Chandler (LAL) establishes a screening position outside of Irving's (BOS) field of view and he does not give him a step to avoid the contact. Additionally, Chandler continues to re-establish himself in Irving's path and delivers contact after the initial contact.
Horford (BOS) maintains legal guarding position and cleanly blocks Ingram's (LAL) shot attempt.
Chandler (LAL) cleanly deflects the ball away from Morris (BOS).
